Hi Jamie / HavenBank team,

I missed you on this morning's 9:00 AM PT redline review — hope everything is OK on your side. We had the SOW and contract redlines on the agenda. To keep momentum, I wanted to propose a short change to the plan: run two focused syncs instead of one long call — a procurement-only 30-minute session to confirm commercial terms and billing, and a separate legal redline deep-dive (45–60 minutes) with your counsel.

Attachments: HavenBank_SOW_v3.pdf; redlines_karthik_20270308.docx (high level highlights are inline in the redlines doc).

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Today, Tue Mar 9: 11:00–11:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed Mar 10: 09:00–09:30 or 15:00–15:45 (legal track)

If none of the above work, please paste a few windows that do or use my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/karthik-havenbank-redlines.

Goal for procurement sync: finalize billing cadence, export controls, and SLA exceptions (if any).
Goal for legal sync: go page-by-page through the redline doc and capture any non-starters so we can prepare countertext.

If you'd prefer we keep a single meeting, happy to do that too — I just want to avoid another long meeting where the right stakeholders aren't available.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
